requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity — plan starting today:
 - Calorie tracking in an app, target ~1600 kcal/day; stop eating after 8 PM; cut takeout to once weekly.
 - Brisk walking with a coworker at lunch 5 days a week.
 - Referred to the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program; RD intake to be scheduled.
 Follow-up visit in ~3 months.
2. Anxiety — stable on sertraline 50 mg; continue.
3. Migraine — rare, sumatriptan PRN effective.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 12/02/2025
Healthy Weight program intake. 3-day food log reviewed: adequate breakfast/lunch; 700–900 kcal of snacking after 9 PM (chips, cookies, ice cream); takeout pizza/Chinese several nights.
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1600 kcal/day; planned evening snack of ≤150 kcal, kitchen "closed" after 8 PM; batch-cook two dinners on Sundays to replace takeout; takeout max 1x/week.
Activity: continue lunchtime brisk walks with coworker, 5 days/week.
RD follow-up in 6–8 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 02/08/2026
S: Weight follow-up. Continues the plan started in November — tracking calories most days, no eating after 8 PM on weeknights, takeout down to once a week. Walking at lunch with coworker most days. Had one RD visit so far, next one scheduled. Good adherence most weeks.
O: Wt 90.8 kg, BMI 32.2. BP 117/67.
A/P:
1. Obesity — continue lifestyle program, reinforce evening routine.
2. Migraine — no recent attacks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/16/2026
Food log reviewed for past month: tracking ~6 days/week, averaging 1550–1700 kcal/day. Adherent most days. Evening snacks now mostly fruit or yogurt. Still one takeout night.
Small adjustments: add protein at lunch to reduce afternoon vending-machine snacks; portion control on weekend dinners.
Reports she keeps up with the lunchtime walks.
Next RD visit per program schedule.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 31.8 — minimal response to lifestyle changes. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration beginning at 0.25 mg weekly. Counseled on GI side effects, slowing down at meals, hydration. Continue diet and activity plan. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.
